description: For a flight-and-hotel package from search_trips: every other flight for the same route and dates, each priced as a package with the same stay, with what it costs each traveller more or less than the current flight. The Vuelo card uses this for its Change flight list; call it yourself when the traveller asks for other flights for a package, then book the offerId they choose.
name: change_package_flight
title: Other flights for a package
